caption: The drawing depicts two human figures, one larger and one smaller. The larger figure stands upright and is dressed in a long yellow robe with a patterned white outer garment that has red dots and black edges. The figure has a halo-like circle with spiked lines around the head, a black beard, and holds a long staff with leaves and round shapes in the right hand. The left arm cradles the smaller figure, who is dressed in a red garment and has short, dark hair. Both figures have pink-toned skin. The background contains blue dotted vertical strokes and is framed by a rectangular border with a black zigzag pattern. There is a large arch over the two figures, colored in red, yellow, tan, and black lines, with red swirling lines extending downward from either side of the arch. The paper is off-white, and the drawing occupies a portion centered within the page.
title: Plate 9: Saint Joseph & Child: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
